subject: Commercial structuring: node-credit vs platform-only SKU for private deployment
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@symphonyhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@symphonyhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Private deploy commercial info request (RFP attached)

Diego —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We circulated the internal RFP and got a few follow-ups from finance and infrastructure about commercial packaging for a VPC/on‑prem rollout. High level asks:

- Can you provide a comparison of a platform‑only SKU (annual platform fee + per-GPU runtime nodes billed separately) vs a node‑credit model (prepaid node credits we draw down)?
- How do you treat platform fee amortization for our auditors (CapEx vs OpEx conversation)?
- We need a clear support ladder: standard SRE support vs enterprise 24/7 oncall (and what’s included in each tier).

Attached is the RFP (Symphony_RFP_Q3.pdf) with estimated steady‑state throughput and a short list of security requirements. We are aiming to finalize commercial structure with procurement by June 1.

Can you loop in pricing / legal if needed and share a short worksheet?

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Sr. Procurement Manager
Symphony Health

Attachment: Symphony_RFP_Q3.pdf (application/pdf, 420 KB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@symphonyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 18:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deploy commercial info request (RFP attached)

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the RFP — forwarding to our commercial team and early thoughts below. Marissa / Irene, looping you in for the detailed worksheet and anything legal/sales needs to see.

Quick take:
- Node credit model: cleaner for customers who want predictable committed spend and easier to map to internal chargebacks. Credits can be structured by node-size (e.g., standard GPU, large GPU) with step‑down pricing as credits increase. Good fit if Symphony wants to prepay and get a fixed unit economics.
- Platform‑only SKU (platform fee + run nodes): better for customers who prefer OpEx and want to separate platform capabilities from hardware consumption. Platform fee covers control plane, observability and audit logs; nodes billed per-hour or per-token depending on on‑prem meter.
- Amortization: we typically provide a suggested accounting note for customers — platform fee can be treated as subscription (OpEx) but some customers amortize over contract term for CapEx treatment; we can provide language for your auditors.
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 24x5 email + standard SLAs), Enterprise (24x7 oncall, named SRE routing, war room support for major incidents) — we’ll detail response times and included runbooks.

I’ll attach a pricing workup (quick draft) in the next message. If you’d like, we can set a 30‑minute call this week to run through the worksheet and get alignment ahead of June 1.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@symphonyhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deploy commercial info request (RFP attached)

Hi Olivia —

Attaching a short worksheet: redwood-private-deploy-pricing-workup.xlsx (see tab names referenced below). Notes and recommended options inline.

Summary of worksheet tabs (high level):
- Assumptions: steady-state GPUs, typical sequence length distribution (from your RFP), on-prem amortization horizon (36 months default).
- NodeCredit_Model: credit SKU definitions (small|standard|large), list prices, volume tiers, recommended minimum commit to unlock 12%–25% discount depending on term and warranty.
- PlatformPlus_Nodes: platform fee tiers (starter | professional | enterprise) with included observability and audit retention, plus per-node/hr and monthly node-subscription pricing.
- Support_Tiers: matrix showing included response times, number of named SREs, design reviews, and 24x7 escalation paths.
- Accounting_Language: suggested contract language for amortization and capital vs operational treatment (two short templates).

Key commercial options for Symphony:
1) Pilot (3 month): platform starter + hourly nodes. No prepay, lower upfront. Useful to validate throughput.
2) Commit (12–36 month): NodeCredit model with 10–18% credit credit discount at 12m, 18–25% at 36m and platform fee discounting if you commit > 24 months. We can tier support at enterprise level for the top band.
3) Hybrid: small prepay for baseline production (node credits) + platform fee annual payment with quarterly reconciliation. This gives predictable minimum and OpEx flexibility for spikes.

Auditor's note: we include a short memo the customer can use. Example: "Platform subscription fees provide ongoing access to the control plane and are expensed as subscription services. Prepaid node credits represent a contractual right to use compute; customers may choose to capitalize based on internal policy and useful life." We will customize if your auditors need different wording.

Next steps I propose:
- Diego/Marissa walkthrough with procurement on Thursday (20 May) 09:00 ET / 06:00 PT (30 min)
- If acceptable, Marissa will formalize an initial term sheet and baseline pricing by May 21.

Thanks — attaching the worksheet.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-private-deploy-pricing-workup.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 95 KB)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@symphonyhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@symphonyhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:43:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deploy commercial info request (RFP attached)

Marissa / Diego —

Thanks for the fast turn. The worksheet is helpful. A few clarifying points from procurement and finance after an internal sync:

- Procurement prefers the hybrid approach (baseline prepay + platform fee) but needs to see an example amortization schedule for the prepaid credits and a one‑page justification for auditors. Can you provide the amortization table for a $1.2M 36‑month prepay (node credits) and the one‑pager?
- Finance also asked whether platform fee discounts are additive to node-credit discounts or if they’re mutually exclusive. Please state clearly in the term sheet whether we can stack discounts when we hit the 36‑month band.
- Support: Enterprise 24x7 oncall is a must; can you confirm average onboard time for named SRE (SLA for resource assignment) and whether runbook creation is included or charged separately?

We’re good to take the Thursday 09:00 ET walkthrough — will send a calendar invite. If you can turn the amortization table and the discount stacking language before the call that would be ideal.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Sr. Procurement Manager
Symphony Health
